h1: SEO, AEO, GEO and AIO audit report: see how Google and AI answer engines see your business
title: SEO, AEO, GEO & AIO Audit Report
excerpt: Get an SEO audit report covering Google SEO, answer engines, AI assistants and schema. See what we check, what you receive and the benefits.
content_html:
SEO, AEO, GEO and AIO audit report: see how Google and AI answer engines see your business

Our SEO audit report checks how your website performs in Google search, in answer boxes and voice results, and in AI assistants such as ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity. You get one clear report that shows what is working, what is holding you back, and a ranked list of fixes, so you know exactly where to start.

What is an SEO, AEO, GEO and AIO audit?

Search has changed. People still use Google, but many now ask AI tools for answers instead. So a modern audit has to cover four layers, not one:

  • SEO (search engine optimization): can Google crawl, understand and rank your pages?
  • AEO (answer engine optimization): do your pages give short, clear answers that win featured snippets, "People also ask" boxes and voice results?
  • GEO (generative engine optimization): do AI assistants mention, cite and recommend your business when people ask about your services?
  • AIO (artificial intelligence optimization): is your brand data structured and consistent, so machines can read it and AI tools describe you correctly?

In short, the audit shows whether you are visible wherever your customers search, from a Google results page to a chatbot answer.

What does the SEO audit report cover?

AreaWhat we check
Technical SEOCrawling and indexing, sitemaps, robots rules, redirects, broken links, HTTPS and mobile-friendliness
Speed and Core Web VitalsLoading, responsiveness and layout stability on mobile and desktop
On-page SEOTitles, meta descriptions, headings, keyphrases, internal links, images and duplicate content
Content qualityReadability, depth, search intent match, topical coverage and freshness
Answer readiness (AEO)Direct answers, FAQ sections, question-led headings and FAQ schema
AI visibility (GEO)Whether ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews mention or cite you for key questions
Entity and schema (AIO)Organization, LocalBusiness, Product and Article schema, consistent name, address and phone, and llms.txt
Local presenceGoogle Business Profile, reviews, citations and location pages
AuthorityBacklink quality, brand mentions and trust signals such as reviews and case studies

What will you receive?

  1. A score for each area, so you can see your strengths and gaps at a glance.
  2. Page-by-page findings for your most important pages, with the exact issue and why it matters.
  3. An AI visibility snapshot showing how AI assistants answer questions about your services today.
  4. A prioritised action plan, ranked by impact and effort, so quick wins come first.
  5. A walkthrough call where we explain the report and answer your questions.

What are the benefits of an SEO audit report?

  • Clarity: you stop guessing and see exactly why rankings, traffic or leads are stuck.
  • Focus: the plan ranks fixes by impact, so your team or agency spends time where it counts.
  • AI-ready visibility: you learn how to appear in AI answers, not just blue links, before competitors do.
  • Fewer wasted costs: it shows which tools, plugins or content are not pulling their weight.
  • A baseline to measure against: after fixes go live, a repeat audit shows real progress.
  • Better leads: pages that answer real questions clearly tend to convert more visitors into enquiries.

How does the audit work?

  1. Share your goals. First, tell us your main services, target locations and competitors.
  2. We crawl and test. Next, we scan your site, check speed and schema, and review your Google Business Profile.
  3. We test AI answers. Then we ask AI assistants the questions your customers ask and record who they recommend.
  4. We build the report. After that, we score each area and turn the findings into a ranked action plan.
  5. We walk you through it. Finally, we explain the results and agree the next steps with you.

Who is the audit for?

The audit suits any business that wants more visibility from search and AI. For example, it helps local service businesses that want to win "near me" searches, B2B firms that need more qualified leads, and ecommerce stores that want more product traffic. It is also useful before a website redesign, so you keep what works and fix what does not.

How the audit connects to our services

Many clients use the report as a roadmap and fix the issues in-house. Others ask us to help. Either way, the findings map to our services: on-page and technical SEO, answer engine optimization, generative engine optimization, AI optimization and Google Business Profile optimization. We also follow Google's own SEO starter guide and the schema.org standard for structured data.

Get your SEO audit report

Ready to see where you stand? Contact the Openink Hub team to request your SEO, AEO, GEO and AIO audit report, or book a free demo and we will show you a sample report.

Frequently asked questions

What is included in an SEO audit report?

It covers technical SEO, speed and Core Web Vitals, on-page SEO, content quality, answer readiness (AEO), AI visibility (GEO), schema and entity data (AIO), local presence and authority, plus a prioritised action plan.

How is an AEO, GEO and AIO audit different from a normal SEO audit?

A normal SEO audit focuses on Google rankings. This audit also checks whether your pages win answer boxes and voice results, and whether AI assistants such as ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity mention and cite your business.

How long does the audit take?

Most audits take about one to two weeks, depending on the size of the site and the number of locations and competitors included.

Do I need to give you access to my website?

No access is needed for the core audit. Read-only access to Google Search Console and Analytics helps us add real traffic and ranking data, but it is optional.

What happens after the audit?

You get a walkthrough call and a ranked action plan. You can fix the issues yourself, or ask Openink Hub to help with SEO, AEO, GEO and AIO work.
author: Hiten Neotia
